name: Set Actor Existing Spritesheet Plugin
author: ladx-gbs
description: Adds an event that repoints an actor at a different spritesheet WITHOUT copying tile data into VRAM — for use when the target tiles are already resident (e.g. a per-room streamed tile band). Ported from the gbs-Ninball project's PinballPlugin (eventSetActorExistingSpritesheet.js / set_actor_existing_spritesheet), stripped down to just this one event.
